ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [CAP 222] (as amended); Companies Act [CAP 191]; Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 33 of 2008; Counter Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act [CAP 290]; Proceeds of Crime Act (as amended); International Companies Regulations (including Beneficial Ownership and Registered Agent provisions, as amended); VFSC AML/CFT Guidance Notes and the VFIU supervisory directives. The VFSC maintains the confidential central register of beneficial owners; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) exercises national FIU functions under the Financial Intelligence Unit Act.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of the passport holder (passport issuable by any sovereign state)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the origin state is a Hague Apostille Convention member) OR Consular Legalization by the Vanuatu Honorary Consulate for non-Apostille states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last 3 months) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank, with notarial attestation by a licensed Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the paying/beneficial owner entity (confirming identity and no adverse conduct)
Certificate of Incumbency, certified registry extract, or certificate of good standing for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae and signed notarized statement of good standing for each proposed director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed director, attested by a Notary Public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, shareholders, directors, and UBOs against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the US OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, HM Treasury sanctions, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the VFSC/VFIU domestic advisories and disqualification statements. PEP determination follows FATF Recommendations 12 and 24: foreign PEPs automatically require senior-management approval, documented source of wealth and source of funds, and enhanced ongoing monitoring; domestic PEPs are assessed on a risk basis. Any sanctions hit, negative PEP determination, or materially inconsistent UBO declaration is an automatic refusal ground for incorporation services.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry — Online Name Search and Reservation Service via www.vfsc.vu (VFSC e-Registry portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are English, French, and Bislama. Company names must be expressed in Latin script (English, French, or romanized Bislama), must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' (International Companies Act permitted suffixes also include 'International Company' where authorized), and must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing name. Non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Cyrillic, or Arabic) are not accepted as the primary name and must be transliterated into Romanized form; a non-Latin parallel descriptor may be shown only after the Latin primary name has been approved.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the VFSC Registrar rejects a proposed name, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file written representations with the Registrar within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice requesting reconsideration. The Registrar must issue a final administrative determination within 21 days of the representations. A subsequent appeal lies to the Minister responsible for financial services, and judicial review may be sought in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]. Name reservations are not extendable; upon expiry of the 30-day reservation window, a fresh reservation application and fee must be submitted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is acceptable for general correspondence and marketing purposes for a non-licensed International Company engaged in MedTech regulatory consulting; however, the statutory registered office must be the physical office of the VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville, where all registers, minutes, and service-of-process documents are kept. A purely virtual arrangement without a licensed physical registered agent is not permissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Estimated probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection of the registered office within the first 12 months is below 5% for a standard-risk, non-licensed International Company. Probability would rise to 10–25% if the company later obtains a VFSC license, becomes a licensed financial dealer, or is subject to an AML/CFT thematic inspection by the VFI Unit.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992, as amended), ss. 2-7 (incorporation), s. 21 (registered office), s. 34 (directors); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [CAP 233] (No. 10 of 1993), ss. 4-6; International Companies Act s. 66 (tax exemption certificate regime)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber and lodged by a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; Certificate of Incorporation issued under the VFSC seal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; International Company may issue shares of no par value with stated capital as low as USD 1. No escrow or deposit account is required by law for formation. Non-resident ownership is unrestricted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) The subscriber shares of the International Company be and are hereby allotted to the initial shareholder(s) as recorded in the register of members, and the consideration declared in the allotment schedule is hereby acknowledged and accepted. (2) The registered office of the Company in Vanuatu, as notified by the licensed registered agent, be and is hereby approved and confirmed as the Company's statutory address. (3) The following persons be and are hereby appointed to office: [Name] as Director, [Name] as Corporate Secretary, and [Name] as Principal Executive Officer, each to serve until removed by ordinary resolution. (4) Any one director be and is hereby authorized to execute banking mandates, engage professional advisors, and file all statutory registrations to carry out the Company's business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Pre-Incorporation Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry via a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed agent to submit a name reservation request listing up to three proposed names in English. The agent searches the VFSC register to confirm no identical or confusingly similar name exists. Upon reservation, the name is held for 30 days pending formal incorporation. Rejection requires submission of an alternative name.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate names (up to 3 alternatives)
Passport copy of the ultimate beneficial owner/subscriber
Registered agent engagement letter (signed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict or undesirability, file a fresh reservation within 5 business days with substitute names; no application fee is forfeited.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) in English, including capital structure, share class provisions, and limitation of liability clauses. The subscriber executes the M&A before a notary or witness, and the first director(s) execute written consents to act. The agent certifies the documents as compliant with Part II of the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Subscriber information sheet and beneficial ownership declaration
Proposed capital structure and shareholder allocation
Signed consent to act of each first director
Notarized/witnessed execution pages of the M&A
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the capital or governance clauses, the agent amends the M&A under a deed of rectification and resubmits without additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — online portal (VUFF) or counter at Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the executed M&A together with Form C (particulars of officers), Form RA (registered agent and registered office consent), and proof of payment of the USD 250 government incorporation fee. The application is scanned into VFSC's registry system and checked for completeness.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (2 certified copies)
Form C — particulars of directors and secretary
Form RA — registered agent and registered office consent
Government fee receipt (USD 250)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a requisition letter is issued, the agent has 14 calendar days to file a deficiency response or amended form; failure leads to a 30-day suspension period before the file is closed, which can be reopened on payment of a reinstatement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, VFSC assigns a unique International Company number and issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal, along with certified copies of the M&A and Form C. The entity legally exists from the date of the certificate; the agent endorses the statutory minute book with the certificate date.
required_dossiers: Incoming approved application file
No additional dossiers required from the applicant at this step
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For a typographical or clerical error on the certificate, the applicant files a written rectification request with the original certificate within 7 business days; VFSC issues a corrected certificate without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Tax Exemption Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and Vanuatu Ministry of Finance (Revenue Division)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (written resolution may be used under s. 34 of the International Companies Act) to allot shares, adopt the registered office, and appoint officers. The Company then applies to VFSC for a Certificate of Tax Exemption confirming exemption from Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, and exchange controls, and receives its registration with no annual reporting obligation except a minimal annual return to VFSC.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
First Board Resolution (allotment, registered office, officers)
Registered office declaration with physical address in Vanuatu
Tax Exemption Certificate application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax exemption certificate is delayed, request an expedited confirmation letter from VFSC; discrepancies in the registered office address are cured by filing a notice of change and paying a nominal administrative fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Activation and Payment Rails Enabling
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Bank of Vanuatu, Bred Bank Vanuatu, or approved licensed commercial bank; alternatively an international financial institution accessible via the Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the full incorporation kit to the chosen bank, complete KYC and source-of-funds forms, and pass the board resolution appointing signatories. For merchant payment acceptance, the Company enrols with a PCI-DSS Level 1 card processor (wire transfer and credit card rails) under the low-risk AML tier assigned to ISIC 7490 consulting activity.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and certified M&A
Bank mandate resolution with signatory specimen signatures
Passport copies and proof of address of directors and beneficial owner
Business description and AML risk questionnaire
Invoice template or engagement letter sample for underwriting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank issues a further information request, respond within 10 business days with a beneficial ownership breakdown and source-of-funds declaration; escalation to the bank's compliance committee is available after 15 days of non-action.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — Vanuatu Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce (MTTIC) administers general trade and business registration only; no sectoral industrial board is triggered for ISIC 7490 regulatory consulting services because the activity is office-based professional services.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no manufacturing, commodities, or physical production permit is required. A municipal business licence from Port Vila Municipality may be required solely if a physical office is established; remote operations under a VFSC-registered office require no operating licence.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based professional consulting does not constitute 'development activity' under Part 5 of the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [CAP 283] and therefore requires no EIA Report or Environmental Registration; a letter of deemed exemption may be obtained from DEPC on request.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge thresholds apply (zero manufacturing effluents). For the office footprint, the Company must comply with the Waste Management Act No. 24 of 2022 (mandatory segregation and authorized disposal), the Water Resources Management Act No. 6 of 2022 (potable water and plumbing standards), and the Ozone Depleting Substances and Synthetic Greenhouse Gases Regulations (refrigerant handling if HVAC systems are maintained).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate to be obtained from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for any leased office premises, demonstrating compliance with the Vanuatu Building Code 2014 (means of egress, extinguishers, smoke alarms). Structural load inspection is required only for premises exceeding two storeys or with special occupancy, per the Public Works Department. Workplace clearance under the Employment Act No. 5 of 2010 includes an occupational safety induction; expatriate staff must hold a valid Work Permit and Occupation Permit issued by the Vanuatu Department of Labour and the Immigration Services respectively.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), operating as the successor to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue; official e-Services portal: https://www.customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is incorporated by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). No statutory income tax TIN is issued because an IC is entirely outside Vanuatu's direct tax net. If the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu or imports goods subject to VAT, it must obtain a VAT registration number (VAT ID) by filing Form VAT-01 with VRCA, providing certified constitutional documents, passport copies of shareholders/beneficial owners, registered office certificate, and a declaration of projected turnover. Approval is typically granted within 7–14 working days; VAT IDs are issued electronically and must be quoted on all VAT invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: An International Company under the Vanuatu International Companies Act is wholly exempt from income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and estate duty. It has no tax residence for Vanuatu domestic income tax purposes and is not taxed on worldwide or Vanuatu-source income. Its only indirect tax exposure arises from Vanuatu VAT registration in respect of taxable supplies made in Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, entity classification election, or hybrid mismatch election exists under Vanuatu law for International Companies. The offshore tax-exempt status is mandatory and non-elective. A foreign-owned IC may voluntarily register for VAT to facilitate input credit recovery on local business expenses, but this does not alter its direct tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246], as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Vatu (VT) 5,000,000 aggregate taxable turnover in any consecutive 12-month period. A non-resident IC is also required to register for VAT from the first day it makes a taxable supply in Vanuatu, unless the supply is wholly zero-rated as an export; imports of goods are subject to VAT at the border regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic fiscal clearance, government e-invoicing, API-based clearance, or digital stamping regime is currently mandated under Vanuatu VAT law. Taxpayers may issue paper or electronic VAT invoices, provided each invoice contains the prescribed particulars: invoice number, date, supplier VAT ID, recipient details, description, tax-exclusive amount, VAT amount, and VAT rate. There is no fiscal device or online authorization requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero percent VAT is claimable on: (i) goods physically exported by the supplier in the course or furtherance of the taxable activity, (ii) goods supplied to a non-resident where title passes outside Vanuatu and goods are removed from Vanuatu within 28 days, (iii) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, provided the services are not performed substantially in Vanuatu, and (iv) services directly related to international transport. The exporter must retain sufficient documentary evidence demonstrating actual exportation and receipt overseas; otherwise the supply is taxable at 12.5%.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA auditors rigorously review export zero-rating claims, applying a substance-over-form analysis. If the exporter cannot produce the mandated documentation or if funds are not repatriated within the 180-day deadline, the zero-rating is retrospectively reversed and VAT becomes payable at 12.5% on the supply, plus interest at 2% per month on the underpaid tax. Input VAT credits previously attributed to the export claim are clawed back. Deliberate or reckless misstatement attracts an administrative penalty of up to 200% of the VAT undercharged and, for fraudulent evasion, criminal prosecution with fines up to VT 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to seven years under the Value Added Tax Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalized exchange control regime. The domestic currency is the Vanuatu Vatu (VUV), which is not officially pegged to a hard currency but is managed against a basket of trading-partner currencies. Current account transactions are generally unrestricted, subject to reporting thresholds. Capital account transactions are permitted but require prior RBV authorization through an authorised dealer (commercial bank) for certain cross-border investments and external borrowings. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, and liquidation proceeds may be freely transferred abroad for International Companies (ICs) after verification of source funds and tax compliance, provided the entity is not engaged in domestic business. Convertibility risk is minimal for non-resident ICs operating offshore. Foreign currency accounts may be held in USD, EUR, GBP, or AUD within the domestic banking system. No central bank guarantee or deposit insurance exists for non-resident IC accounts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement exists in Vanuatu. Exporters and offshore services providers, including regulatory consulting firms, are not required to convert foreign currency receipts into VUV within any timeline. Receipts may be retained in the original currency in foreign-currency bank accounts. However, entities must report inward remittances above VUV 100,000 to the authorised dealer for exchange-control recordkeeping and maintain underlying contractual evidence, invoices, and regulatory service agreements for six years. No mandatory conversion ratio applies.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI (Electronic Money Institution) viability is Moderately Low. Vanuatu is not part of a Passporting Framework such as SEPA or the UK FCA Temporary Permissions Regime. EMIs incorporated in other jurisdictions cannot access the local VUV clearing system and are not supervised by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu. Non-resident ICs should use global EMIs (e.g., US MSB/FinCEN-registered, Singapore MPI, or EU EMI) for USD/EUR/GBP settlement; however, RBV exchange-control reporting requires incoming wire evidence to be routed through a local authorised dealer if funds need to be converted into VUV. Segregation between EMI operational accounts and Vanuatu treasury functions is legally permissible only if no VUV clearing or domestic banking services are provided, which materially reduces utility. A Cayman/Channel Island or Singapore licensed digital bank holding a correspondent banking relationship with BSP/ANZ provides a safer intermediary for cross-border dollar clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu banks require in-person onboarding for International Companies in most circumstances. Directors, beneficial owners, and the signatory must appear physically or, in limited cases, may be represented through a licensed Vanuatu trustee or registered agent who signs a declaration of directorship and source-of-funds attestation. Remote video KYC is accepted by certain tier-two banks only after prior relationship and referral by a Vanuatu licensed agent; however, the final Resolution of Account Opening Request and account activation requires a physical or attested signature. A management visit to the World Trade Center in Port Vila is strongly recommended, combining bank interviews, registered agent verification, and notarization. Remote opening is not independently permitted for non-resident ICs with no pre-existing relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory Consulting Income generated from Medical Device Compliance services without tangible goods delivery
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed fee schedule per client engagement; executed Consulting Service Agreement; FDA 510(k) submission proof (eSubmission eSTAR Submission ID, FDA acknowledgement letter, user fee payment receipt of Section 738 FDA Fees); CE Marking Technical File index and Notified Body certificate or Declaration of Conformity, EN ISO 13485 Quality Management Certificate; company profile on ISIC 7490; client invoices with invoice number, dates, service milestones; source-of-funds declaration enumerating non-Russian, non-sanctioned counterparties; passport copies of ultimate beneficial owners; board resolution approving fee structure; bank-statement explanation letter showing monthly retainer transfers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border client payments from diverse jurisdictions triggering nil-tax offshore structure scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: International Company Certificate of Incorporation issued by Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); current Certificate of Good Standing issued within 30 days; IRO (International Companies and Offshore Provisions) Act, Cap 250 compliance confirmation; registered agent compliance certificate; Economic Substance Declaration confirming pure offshore/solicited-only consultation activity and no local trading; completed VFSC Annual Compliance Return; tax-exempt status letter or reviewed financial statements showing zero Vanuatu source income; details of physical or virtual business function in Vanuatu if any; explanation of management and control exercised outside Vanuatu; corporate bank reference letter from the home jurisdiction bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of Credit Card payment rails, unusual for B2B regulatory consulting
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment card merchant statement and settlement flow showing cardholder credit information; commercial rationale statement (speed of retainer settlement, small-ticket verification work for startups); Customer Due Diligence pack for each card-paying client; evidence that card payments are limited to US$10,000 per milestone per client; screenshot of Stripe/PayPal API security settings; abandoned checkout evidence or underlying pay-in agreements; QSP/PSP due diligence and processing bank reference in Vanuatu and/or Singapore.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Named entities and civil penalties involving US FDA or EU CE Notified Body interactions for a Vanuatu-based intermediary
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registration as consultant under 21 CFR 807.65 with FDA establishment registration (when applicable); letter of non-engagement for actual manufacturing of medical devices; ISO 13485 consulting scope statement; bullseye US Agent agreement if represented for 510(k) files; Eudamed Organisation actor registration confirmation for CE Marking economic operator roles; email evidence showing no access to client device quality data except as required for regulatory letters; memorandum of exclusivity for regulatory-only services; written legal opinion from US FDA counsel and EU Notified Body confirming jurisdictional clearing-house role is advisory and not a submission-initiating activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial capital injections and operating liquidity must enter Vanuatu via SWIFT wire from the beneficial owner's corporate or personal bank account matching the name on the VFSC registration and bank account. Recommended routing: Originator bank (US/EU/HK/SG) to a US Dollar correspondent of ANZ Vanuatu or BRED Vanuatu, using SWIFT MT103. The payment method must include Remittance Information field (Field 70): 'SHARE CAPITAL - VU_IC / INVOICE' with purpose code EXCHANGE CONTROL APPROVED - CAPITAL INJECTION. For amounts above VUV 100,000, the authorised dealer bank will request an Source of Wealth Statement, certified copy of the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, and a board resolution authorising the capital deposit. The RBV Balance of Payments classification should be 'Direct Investment: Equity Capital' or 'Other Capital Transfer' if operating expense. For monthly expense funding, the purpose code 'OTHER PRIVATE SERVICES - REGULATORY FEES' may be used, but the beneficiary's invoice must be retained. No local clearing of ACH or Faster Payments is available; all inbound routing must be SWIFT. Avoid overboxed remittance descriptions containing 'FDA', 'CE', 'MONEY LAUNDERING', or 'MEDICAL DEVICE' alone; use neutral yet accurate commercial description 'CONSULTING FEES' or 'CORPORATE SETTLEMENT' controlled by the underlying agreement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for regulatory filing fees (FDA user fees, EU Notified Body fees), subcontractor consultants, and purchase of software subscriptions shall be conducted via SWIFT MT103 through a foreign currency account maintained at ANZ or BRED. For Vanuatu VUV operations, the bank will apply FTT (Foreign Transaction Tax) as applicable; for USD/EUR/AUD, no conversion fee is imposed. Commercial Letters of Credit are not appropriate for intangible consulting disbursements; instead, MT103 with irrevocable payment order and a detailed Commercial Invoice is the correct rail. Chinese suppliers or technical testing labs that require LC may be settled through a confirmed bank-provided LC using the Vanuatu Bank's correspondent network, but the underlying ISIC 7490 activity does not generate physical merchandise trade. For recurring subscriptions (FDA eSTAR, EUDAMED access, EN ISO 13485 documentation software) permitted rails are SEPA Credit Transfer if the EU FI accepts SWIFT/IBAN, or card payment via corporate credit card for small-value licenses. Any payment above US$50,000 in USD equivalent requires field 70 to include 'VEN/IC-ADV/INV [INVOICE NUMBER]' and underlying contract custody. Full MT103 trail and covering bank details must be maintained for six years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company (Form AR-IC) setting out registered office, registered agent, members, directors, and charges
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after the expiry of each 12-month period from the date of incorporation (anniversary date + 1 month)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing: fine up to VUV 100,000 (~USD 830) plus continuing daily penalty of VUV 500 (~USD 4); failure to file or pay annual fees for more than 6 months exposes the company to administrative strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 1992

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Compliance Confirmation and Beneficial Ownership Record Refresh, including declaration of any share transfers during the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent acting under VFSC supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Coincident with annual return filing date (anniversary date + 1 month) or on the agent's prescribed renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or confirm UBO records exposes the agent to VFSC administrative penalties and may disqualify the company's registration; persistent non-confirmation without lawful excuse leads to compulsory strike-off of the company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for a standard Vanuatu International Company; compulsory audit applies only to VFSC-licensed financial institutions, insurance entities, banks, or management company licensees, and in any case where members holding at least 10% of the issued shares requisition an audited account under the International Companies Act 1992
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) recommended as the acceptable framework; the International Companies Act 1992 requires true and fair financial records but does not prescribe a local statutory GAAP and does not require filing of financial statements for a standard IC

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public UBO registry exists in Vanuatu; the licensed registered agent must hold verified beneficial ownership records and refresh them annually as part of the annual return process; any share transfer during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members and reported to the agent, with the annual confirmation attesting the current UBO position as at the anniversary date

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–5,000 (only applicable if an audit is required; otherwise not incurred)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu does not levy corporate income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, or any income-based tax on International Companies formed under the International Companies Act 1993, provided the company does not carry on local trading activity in Vanuatu. The effective tax burden on eligible offshore MedTech regulatory consulting revenue is 0%; the only recurring state impost is the annual VFSC government fee and the registered agent fee. VAT applies only to local actual supplies in Vanuatu and does not apply to offshore consulting services rendered to non-resident clients.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No national corporate income tax return form exists for International Companies in Vanuatu. The only mandatory annual online compliance filing is the VFSC International Company Annual Licence/Exemption Return submitted by the licensed registered agent through the VFSC e-Services portal; if the IC registers for VAT locally (which is uncommon for pure offshore consulting), a VAT return under the Value Added Tax Act must be filed through the Vanuatu VAT online system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC annual exemption fee, signed declaration of particulars, and registered agent confirmation are due on or before 30 June of each calendar year. For an IC incorporated mid-year, the first return is due on the anniversary date set in the certificate or the statutory renewal date prescribed by the VFSC; the registered agent's renewal notice confirms the exact date. There is no CIT deadline because no CIT return is assessed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: A. Company Legal Name and IC Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the International Company under the International Companies Act, including the VFSC certificate number and exact registered name.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full legal name shown on the incorporation certificate; add the designation International Company as required by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: B. Registered Agent and Registered Office Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certifies that the IC maintains a licensed registered agent and a registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent completes this field on behalf of non-resident shareholders and directors; no notarisation abroad is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: C. Shareholder and Director Ledger Particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Records current non-resident directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners as maintained in the company register available to the VFSC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide full names, passport numbers, foreign residential addresses, and ownership percentages; nominee shareholder arrangements must be disclosed to the registered agent and kept in the agent's beneficial ownership file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: D. Declaration of No Local Business in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirms that the IC has not carried on any business in Vanuatu within the meaning of the International Companies Act, including local physical offices, local employees, or domestic sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State that all FDA/CE regulatory consulting services are performed for non-residents and that no Vanuatu source revenue, real property interest, or taxable local supply existed during the reporting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: E. Annual Government Exemption Fee Remittance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the prescribed VFSC annual government fee to keep the IC in good standing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders or the registered agent may remit the fee in Vatu or US dollars by wire transfer; no Vanuatu tax withholding applies to this internal fee payment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission of the VFSC annual return/exemption fee triggers escalating late-payment penalties, suspension or striking-off of the International Company, and restoration fees to re-instate the legal entity. Since Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, there are no CIT late-return surcharges or daily CIT penalties. If the IC nevertheless becomes a VAT-registered local taxpayer, late VAT returns attract fixed late-filing penalties and interest under the VAT Act, in addition to possible cancellation of the VAT registration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not concluded any comprehensive double taxation agreement and therefore does not operate a source-state treaty relief process. Dividends paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-resident shareholders are not subject to Vanuatu dividend withholding tax and do not require a tax residency certificate, TRC application, or tax clearance from the Vanuatu Revenue. The shareholder must rely exclusively on home-jurisdiction foreign tax credit, participation exemption, or CFC rules for any taxation of the dividend in the state of residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu imposes no statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties or debt interest paid by an International Company to non-residents. An IC may license FDA/CE regulatory documentation, trademarks, and know-how to an offshore parent or sister company and receive interest from intra-group loans free of any Vanuatu source tax. No treaty reduction is available or needed because Vanuatu has no comprehensive DTAs; foreign anti-hybrid rules and transfer pricing recharacterisation remain the relevant risk.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Vanuatu threshold exists. As best practice and to defend the structure against foreign tax authority inquiries, maintain contemporaneous OECD Master File/Local File documentation whenever annual controlled transactions of the Vanuatu IC exceed VUV 100,000,000 (approximately USD 830,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not maintain a domestic Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to the BVI or UAE. However, foreign tax authorities, correspondent banks, and the VFSC will assess whether the IC has genuine substance relative to its revenue. For a medical-device regulatory consultancy, the IC should hold actual board minutes in Vanuatu, maintain accounting records with a Vanuatu bookkeeper, process fee invoicing from a Vanuatu bank account, enter consultancy agreements under Vanuatu law, and avoid being managed solely from the parent company's high-tax jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC as a pure tax shelter where all substantive FDA 510(k) and CE Mark consultancy activities, marketing, client negotiation, and project management occur in the US/EU, with no actual staff, physical presence, or operating capability in Vanuatu, and invoicing substantially all group profit into the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC may be struck off by the VFSC for failing to maintain a licensed agent or records; the foreign tax jurisdiction may apply CFC, anti-avoidance, or section 482-type reallocation rules, imposing back tax, interest, and accuracy-related penalties of up to 20-40% of the understated tax and criminal referral for offshore tax fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly caused the offshore attribution of profits are personally exposed to civil restitution, piercing of the corporate veil, director disqualification, travel restrictions pending tax investigation, and imprisonment in the beneficial-owner's home jurisdiction for tax evasion offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Shell Company Banking Red Flag
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as an unsubstantial cash-box with no coherent commercial purpose; accepting rapid round-trip wires from unknown third parties; making shareholder loans disguised as dividends; or refusing to produce supporting invoices for the medical-device consulting fees deposited into the Vanuatu account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Correspondent banks may block the account, file a STR/SAR, and terminate the banking relationship; under Vanuatu AML/CFT legislation the VFSC may fine the IC, suspend the registered agent, and strike off the company. The company's assets may be frozen during a suspicious transaction investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors or beneficial owners who conceal the economic substance of transfers risk civil asset forfeiture, personal fines, travel bans imposed as part of an AML investigation, and imprisonment for wilful money laundering or aiding tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Defective Transfer Pricing Documentation / False Intercompany Charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging management fees, IP royalties, or service commissions to US/EU affiliates at non-arm's-length prices without invoices, underlying time records, or evidence of actual benefit received; alternatively, reporting zero economic capacity while earning multi-million-dollar consulting revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Although Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing penalty regime, the US/EU parent jurisdiction can deny deductions for payments to the Vanuatu IC, impose transfer-pricing penalties of 20-40% of the adjustment, apply CFC inclusion of the IC's earnings, and challenge the tax-exempt status of the structure as a sham.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false documentation or fail to oversee substance may be jointly and severally liable for corporate tax liabilities by piercing the veil, subject to director disqualification and criminal prosecution for false statement in the jurisdiction that asserts the tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed On-Shore Activity / False No-Local-Business Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming IC tax-exempt status while physically maintaining a Vanuatu office, hiring Vanuatu residents, rendering services for the benefit of Vanuatu clients, or conducting meetings and managerial decisions inside Vanuatu without holding a local business licence and VAT registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC loses its exempt-character status, becoming liable to corporation-type licensing fees, VAT on local supplies, and strict liability offences under Vanuatu's business licensing and VAT framework; VFSC may impose fines and cancel the IC's registration for knowingly false annual declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the false declaration of no local business face civil fines, repayment of unpaid government fees, disqualification from acting as officers, court-ordered travel bans where the state is pursuing recovery, and imprisonment for perjury or fraud.
